scope: One 2-3-person team; controlled numerical design-coordination prototype, not industrial BIM or a population user study
live_policy: Full import at gate; checks after 45 seconds; no mid-window payload import
primary_comparison: Same observed publication trace: All at 15 seconds versus All at 45 seconds
secondary_comparisons: Gq, G0 and Iq at six-file quota, each at both delays; latest-version service and exact predicate-verdict agreement reported separately
task_inputs: Four three-input clearance checks plus three four-input connection checks; topology fixed in model.py
event_source: Actual participant publish actions, server monotonic timestamps, immutable JSON payloads and hash-chained records; never generated release events
request_cards: Coordinator manually releases cards 1,2,3 at elapsed approximately 180,420,660 seconds and records release times
stopping_rule: Three planned completed sessions regardless of results. Preserve aborted sessions and reasons. No event-count/effect-size stopping rule or retuning from outcomes
analysis_unit: Session descriptive summaries for one team; do not treat windows/tasks as independent people or report population significance
counterfactual_limit: Offline replay holds publication times fixed; not a randomized behavioral intervention or proof of how people would react under a different policy
data_separation: PRACTICE, FIXTURE and FORMAL directories separate; automated software tests are never participant observations
